phone.pairLead: The phone is on Wi-Fi. This computer is not paired.
phone.steps:
On the phone, open Settings, Developer options, Wireless debugging.
Tap Pair device with pairing code.
Leave that screen open. It shows a 6-digit code.
phone.codeLabel: Type that code in this box.
phone.noPopup: That pairing screen is not open yet. Open it, then press Look again.
phone.offSteps: On the phone, turn on Developer options, Wireless debugging. Then press Look again.
phone.pairedWait: Paired. The phone is not connected yet. Leave Wireless debugging open, then press Look again.
phone.failed: Pairing failed. Check the code. Leave the phone screen open.
phone.many: More than one phone is on this Wi-Fi.
phone.unauthorized: Unlock the phone and tap Allow.
phone.tooltip: Phone. Click to open, or to pair.
